title: Who is where? vagyok, vagy, van

sections.title: Matching the verb
sections.content: The verb changes with the person who is in the place. *Vagyok* goes with “I”, *vagy* goes with “you”, and *van* goes with anyone or anything else: Anna, Károly, the key. The place stays right before the verb.

sections.title: To be somewhere
rows: he, she, it or Anna is (in a place)

items.english: Are you in the living room?

sections.content: *Van* is the verb you meet most often, in *Hol van ...?*, so it is tempting to use it for everybody. Keep the three apart: if you are the one in the place, say *vagyok*; if you ask or say where the person you are talking to is, say *vagy* (*Hol vagy?*). Use *van* for everybody else: *Hol van Anna?*
